title: Prompt registry entries are explicit and replayable
description: Every prompt used by an LLM or agent shadow task must be declared in prompt_registry.json with a stable prompt_id, version, owner stage, input artifacts, output artifact, output schema, fallback behavior, and harness cases.
failure_examples: prompt file exists but has no registry entry
registry entry points to a missing prompt file
LLM task has no fallback when JSON parsing fails
prompt output schema is described only in prose and not linked from the registry
